title: Poor West / When will ...?
subtitle: 可怜的伊恩 / 什么时候将……？

lead.question: 好邻居要搬走了，你会怎样送别？怎么用英语打听「他什么时候搬」「新房客什么时候搬进来」？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象三位太太在门口聊天：韦斯特先生上星期把房子卖了，明天下午就要搬走，新房客后天搬进来。聊天里自然会冒出大量将来时：He's going to move tomorrow.（他打算明天搬家）、They will move in the day after tomorrow.（他们后天搬进来）、I'll miss him.（我会想念他的）。再留意结尾那个小反转——他本不想搬，可他妻子想搬！
goals: 掌握一般将来时 will/shall + 动词原形及其缩写 'll / won't / shan't
能用 be going to 表示打算与即将发生的事
熟记将来时常用时间状语：tomorrow (morning/afternoon), the day after tomorrow, next week, in two days' time 等
会用 not yet（还没有）和 give one's regards to sb.（代为问候）
lead.summary: 第 91 课三位太太闲谈邻居：韦斯特先生上星期卖掉了房子，明天下午搬家，新房客后天搬进来。大家都舍不得这位好邻居，还要布朗太太代为问候；结尾揭晓：他本不想离开，是他妻子要离开。第 92 课操练一般将来时：把句子缩写成 He'll arrive tomorrow morning，并用「It snowed last night. — Yes, and it will snow tomorrow, too.」练 will 句型。
lead.tips: ① will 可用于所有人称，shall 只用于第一人称 I/we 表单纯将来，缩写 shan't = shall not，won't = will not；② 口语里 be going to 更常用，表意图打算（I'm going to move）或有迹象即将发生（It's going to rain.）；③ all 指三个或以上「都」（We shall all miss him.），两个人用 both；④ ...but his wife did! 中的 did 代替前文的 wanted to leave，避免重复；⑤ not yet 还没有，回应 Has he moved yet? 这类现在完成时问句。

questions.q: Who wanted to sell the house?
questions.a: Mr West's wife (did). He didn't want to leave, but his wife did!
questions.aZh: 韦斯特先生的妻子想卖。他本不想离开，可他妻子要离开！

questions.q: When did Mr West sell his house, and when is he going to move?
questions.zh: 韦斯特先生什么时候卖掉房子的？他打算什么时候搬？
questions.a: He sold it last week. He's going to move tomorrow afternoon.
questions.aZh: 他上星期卖掉的，打算明天下午搬。
questions.hint: 一个过去时，一个将来时。

questions.q: When will the new people move into the house?
questions.zh: 新房客什么时候搬进这所房子？
questions.a: Mrs Brown thinks they will move in the day after tomorrow.
questions.aZh: 布朗太太想他们后天搬进来。
questions.hint: move in 后面跟的时间。

questions.q: What does Mrs Green ask Mrs Brown to do?
questions.zh: 格林太太请布朗太太做什么？
questions.a: She asks her to give Mr West her regards.
questions.aZh: 请她代自己向韦斯特先生问候。

questions.q: Why do the neighbours say 'Poor Mr West'? What does poor mean here?
questions.zh: 邻居们为什么说 Poor Mr West？这里的 poor 是什么意思？
questions.a: Poor here means 'unfortunate, to be pitied' — he didn't want to leave the house he had lived in, but his wife wanted to. It does not mean 'not rich'. 参考答案：poor 这里是「可怜的」，不是「贫穷的」——他不想离开却不得不搬。
questions.aZh: poor 这里是「可怜的」，表示同情；他不想离开这幢房子，可他妻子想离开。
questions.hint: 想想 Poor man! 在中文里常怎么说。

questions.q: It snowed last night. — Yes, and it will snow tomorrow, too.
questions.zh: 第 92 课操练：昨晚下了雪。——是的，明天还会下。（用「一般过去时 + will ... tomorrow, too」操练将来时）
questions.a: He got up late this morning. — Yes, and he will get up late tomorrow, too.
questions.aZh: 他今天早上起晚了。——是的，明天他还会起晚。
questions.hint: 前句过去时，后句 will + 动词原形 + tomorrow, too。

meanings.usage: He's still here. 他还在这儿；也可表「还要、甚至更」

examples.en: No, not yet. He's still here.

meanings.usage: move to a new house 搬进新居；move in 迁入

examples.en: Has he moved to his new house yet?

meanings.usage: 另义「错过」：miss the train 错过火车（见第 95 课）

examples.en: I'll miss him.

meanings.usage: 美式拼法 neighbor；next-door neighbour 隔壁邻居

examples.en: He has always been a good neighbour.

meanings.usage: a very nice person 一个非常好的人；复数 persons/people

examples.en: He's a very nice person.

meanings.usage: 集合名词，无复数；the new people 新住户

examples.en: When will the new people move into this house?
examples.zh: 新住户什么时候搬进这所房子？

meanings.usage: 表同情，置于名词前：Poor Mr West!；另义「贫穷的」

examples.en: Poor Mr West! He didn't want to leave this house.
examples.zh: 可怜的韦斯特先生！他本不想离开这幢房子。

meanings.usage: 过去式 left；leave a place 离开某地

examples.en: He didn't want to leave this house.
examples.zh: 他本不想离开这幢房子。

examples.en: No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did!
examples.zh: 是啊，他是不想离开，可是他妻子要离开！

meanings.usage: shall I/we 表单纯将来；缩写 shan't = shall not

examples.en: We shall all miss him.
examples.zh: 我们大家都会想念他的。

meanings.usage: give one's regards to sb. 向某人问候，常用复数

examples.en: Please give him my regards.

meanings.usage: a nice person 好人；夸人常用词

examples.en: He's a very nice person.

lines.speaker: MRS SMITH
lines.en: Has Mr West sold his house yet?
lines.zh: 韦斯特先生已把他的房子卖掉了吗？
lines.note: 凯瑟琳；现在完成时 + yet

lines.speaker: MRS BROWN
lines.en: Yes, he has. He sold it last week.
lines.zh: 是的，卖掉了。他上星期卖掉的。

lines.speaker: MRS SMITH
lines.en: Has he moved to his new house yet?

lines.speaker: MRS BROWN
lines.en: No, not yet. He's still here. He's going to move tomorrow.
lines.zh: 不，还没有。他仍在这里。他打算明天搬家。
lines.note: not yet 还没有；be going to 表打算

lines.speaker: MRS BROWN
lines.en: No. Tomorrow afternoon. I'll miss him. He has always been a good neighbour.
lines.zh: 不，明天下午。我会想念他的。他一直是个好邻居。

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.en: He's a very nice person. We shall all miss him.
lines.zh: 他是个非常好的人，我们大家都会想念他的。
lines.note: 琳达；all 作 we 的同位语

lines.speaker: MRS SMITH
lines.en: When will the new people move into this house?
lines.zh: 新住户什么时候搬进这所房子？

lines.speaker: MRS BROWN
lines.en: I think that they will move in the day after tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我想他们将会在后天搬进来吧。

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.en: Will you see Mr West today, Mrs Brown?
lines.zh: 詹尼，您今天会见到韦斯特先生吗？

lines.speaker: MRS SMITH
lines.en: Poor Mr West! He didn't want to leave this house.
lines.zh: 可怜的韦斯特先生！他本不想离开这幢房子。

lines.speaker: MRS BROWN
lines.en: No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did!
lines.zh: 是啊，他是不想离开，可是他妻子要离开！
lines.note: did 代替 wanted to leave

drill.q: He/She/It ___ yesterday / this morning. — Yes, and he/she/it will ___ tomorrow, too.
drill.zh: 他（她/它）昨天……了。——是的，明天还会……。（前句一般过去时，后句 will + 动词原形 + tomorrow, too）

slots.zh: 开车去伦敦 — 昨天（她）
给他打电话 — 昨天（她）

answers: It snowed last night. Yes, and it will snow tomorrow, too.
He got up late this morning. Yes, and he will get up late tomorrow, too.

exercises.q: 把 He will arrive tomorrow morning. 缩写成口语形式。
exercises.note: will 缩写为 'll，口语最常用。

exercises.q: 把 It will snow tonight. 改成否定句（缩写）。
汉译英：新住户后天搬进来。
exercises.a: The new people will move in the day after tomorrow.
exercises.note: the day after tomorrow 后天，配将来时。

exercises.q: It snowed last night. 补一句：明天还会下。
exercises.a: Yes, and it will snow tomorrow, too.
exercises.note: will 问 will 答，too 放句末。

exercises.q: 汉译英：请代我向他问候。
exercises.note: give one's regards to sb. 向某人问候。

exercises.q: He didn't want to leave, but his wife ____. （用一句话补全）
exercises.a: did（= his wife wanted to leave）
exercises.note: did 代替上文的 wanted to leave，避免重复。

quiz.q: 一般将来时的基本形式是：
quiz.note: will/shall 后接动词原形；will 可用于所有人称。

quiz.q: We shall all miss him. 中 shall 用于：
quiz.note: shall 表单纯将来时只用于第一人称。

quiz.q: It's going to rain. 这句话表示：
options: 有迹象表明快要下雨了
quiz.note: be going to 也可表示有迹象某事即将发生。
not yet 还没有；already 一般用于肯定句。

quiz.q: Poor Mr West! 中 poor 的意思是：
options: 可怜的→此处表同情，不是穷
quiz.note: poor 置于称呼前表同情「可怜的」；与「贫穷」无关。

quiz.q: No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did! 中 did 代替：
quiz.note: did 代替上文的 wanted to leave，避免重复动词。

grammar.title: 一般将来时（will / shall）
grammar.structure: will/shall + 动词原形；缩写 'll；否定 won't / shan't
grammar.definition: 表示将来某一时刻的动作、状态与打算，一般与表示将来的时间状语连用。will 可用于所有人称；shall 只用于第一人称 I/we 表单纯将来。
grammar.usage: 常配 tomorrow, this month, the day after tomorrow, next week, in two days' time, from now on 等。

examples.en: I shan't leave tonight. I'll leave tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今天夜里我不走，我明天走。

examples.en: When will the new people move into this house?
examples.zh: 新住户什么时候搬进这所房子？

grammar.title: be going to 表打算与即将发生
grammar.structure: am/is/are going to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 口语中表示将来，比 will/shall 更普通：一是表示说话人的意图或打算，二是表示有迹象某事即将发生。
grammar.usage: She is going to travel by air. / It's going to rain.

examples.en: He's going to move tomorrow.
It's going to rain.

grammar.title: all 的位置与 did 代替动词短语
grammar.structure: We shall all miss him. / ..., but his wife did.
grammar.definition: all（指三个或以上「都」；两者用 both）作主语同位语，放在 be 后、实义动词前或 shall/will 之后。答句中的 did 可代替上文的动词短语，避免重复。
grammar.usage: He didn't want to leave, but his wife did (= wanted to leave).

examples.en: We shall all miss him.
examples.zh: 我们大家都会想念他的。

examples.en: No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did!
examples.zh: 是啊，他是不想离开，可是他妻子要离开！

phrases.usage: 还没有（回应完成时问句）

examples.en: Has he moved to his new house yet? — No, not yet.
examples.zh: 他迁进新居了吗？——还没有。

examples.en: They will move in the day after tomorrow.
I think that they will move in the day after tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我想他们将会在后天搬进来吧。

examples.en: Please give him my regards.
I'll miss him.
